name: brand-not-embedded
body: kalide's own brand collateral lives in the repository/documentation only: every file under `brand/` (currently `brand/logo_light.svg`, `brand/logo_dark.svg` and `brand/LICENSE`). Brand files are referenced from documentation and marketing surfaces and stay outside the binary and the deck runtime: no `brand/` file is go:embed'ed, placed under `internal/assets`, or referenced from the served deck/error/gallery page shells or the `kalide init` seed. This applies kalide's core-unbranded law (global.constraint.core-unbranded, global.constraint.go-static-embedded-binary, global.constraint.no-embedded-template-assets) to kalide's own identity. A `brand/` file is licensed all rights reserved (Really Knows AI) under `brand/LICENSE`, not Apache-2.0: it stays under `brand/`, where the repo-root Apache-2.0 LICENSE does not reach.
